title: Restriction of coefficient systems preserves the specified section casts
statement: For every map g:N to Nprime of coefficient sequence modules on a scheme W, level n, pro-etale object U and section x of N at (n,U), restricting g to level n and applying it to the specified restricted section of x equals the specified restricted section of g(x). This is naturality of the section cast, with notation as in [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models] and [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site].

source.place: 03D7, ordinary scalar-extension adjunction; 03EK, tensor products. Fully proved ordinary substep of the strict scalar quotient comparison.

proof.text: The restriction functor is characterized by HEq of its underlying map on each section with the original map g on the sequence-site section. The specified restricted section is the cast along the recorded carrier equality. Transport the map across its domain and codomain carrier equalities using equality elimination. The HEq characterization then gives precisely the asserted equality. The module also proves the analogous evaluation and eqToHom identities directly by equality elimination.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary balanced tensor and adjunction-unit naturality; fully proved private implementation helper, not a new sorry obligation.

lean.statement:
theorem restriction_map_section {X : Scheme.{t}}
    {N N' : coefficientSequenceModules l E X} (g : N ⟶ N')
    (n : ℕ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : N.val.obj (op (n, U.unop))) :
    ((((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).map g).app (op n)).val.app U)
      (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E X N n U x) =
    integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E X N' n U
      (g.val.app (op (n, U.unop)) x)
